maya: Quick log for mini-beam (tiny-beam variant) bring-up on rdx-13b-q3_k. Summary: p99 latency dropped ~20%, throughput +30-40%, small quality delta concentrated on long-code answers. Dropping notes for ops and eval. :spiral_notepad:

raj: Which holdouts used?

maya: 10k prod-sim multi-turn + 2k safety/QA. Canary config: baseline=greedy, treatment=tiny-beam (beam=2, early-abort=0.12).

sam: Run command?

maya: ```bash
python run_eval.py --model rdx-13b-q3_k --policy tinybeam --beam 2 --early_abort 0.12 --holdout holdouts/prod_sim_10k.json --out results/tinybeam_run.json
```

maya: Metrics: quick human sample (n=500) accept-rate delta = -0.6pp (not significant yet). Token logprob gap: baseline avg -1.9 vs tinybeam -2.15; divergence at code tokens. One repro below.

maya: ```
PROMPT: "Explain CRDTs and give an example with code."
BASELINE: long, correct explanation + working pseudocode
TINYBEAM: shorter explanation, missed convergence caveat, non-compiling snippet
LOGPROB GAP: spike around code block tokens
```

raj: Early-abort may cut low-prob tails needed for correct phrasing; quant jitter likely amplifies.

maya: Grid quick-check: beam=3, abort=0.08 -> p99 down ~12%, throughput +20%, accept-rate delta ~-0.1pp. Tradeoff tunable.

perf-bot: perf-bot: p50 96ms->65ms (-32%), p99 230ms->180ms (-22%), tokens/sec 720->960 (+33%).

sam: Proposal: full A/B 100k stratified (long-answer/code/dialogue), save token-aligned logprobs to S3, run same policy on q4_x quant to isolate quant noise, and localized human label on 2k safety set (5 reviewers).

raj: Add KV-cache cold vs warm runs; speculative policies may interact with cache patterns.

maya: Opening ticket, attaching diff-viewer outputs and flagging failing prompts in eval alert set. Will include rollback criteria.

eli: Canary rollback criteria: p99 latency > +10% vs baseline OR accept-rate delta < -0.5pp OR any safety holdout fail. Put this in the ticket.

sam: Starting 100k sweep now: ./scripts/run_ab_sweep.sh --model rdx-13b-q3_k --policy tinybeam --beam 2 --abort 0.12 --size 100000 --out s3://redwood-eval/tinybeam/100k/ ETA ~8h on benchcluster (24 workers). Logging to #eng-ml-eval.

maya: If sweep shows accept-rate delta within -0.2pp and hallucinations <0.05% prompts, we can try 5% canary rollout with strict rollback hooks; else iterate policy or use q4_x. Tagging @eli @sam for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
